rule_objections: Rule is clear and I agree with it. Counting procs nested in a proc (template addNode) and variables in `when isMainModule` (f, f2, f3, r) as definitions is arguable; they are test-fixture locals in practice.
findings: All 51 expected definitions found with correct kind family and lines, 0 missed, 0 spurious. Forward declaration (parseUrlQuery), backquoted operator `{}`, templates in `when` branches, both NativeRequest aliases in the two `when` branches, and enums/objects all handled.
Sample is small: jester has only three .nim files under 800 lines (198/196/141 lines); the largest file jester.nim (1458 lines) is excluded by the rule, so heavy macro/DSL code was not exercised.
not_done: Did not test a bigger Nim project (stdlib, nimble).
